name: Simplified Technical English (ASD-STE100)
description: Clarify technical instructions, tool descriptions, and agent messages while preserving their meaning, conditions, and uncertainty.
author: Dustin Yuchen Teng
coverImageAlt: Tangled paper ribbons pass through a navy guide and emerge as one straight strip, illustrating clear technical instructions.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org skill gallery cover
Primary request: an editorial metaphor for simplifying ambiguous technical language into one clear instruction.
Scene/backdrop: a quiet workbench against a flat deep slate field with ample negative space.
Subject: a small tangle of three blank warm-paper ribbons enters one smooth navy ceramic alignment guide; a single neatly straightened warm-paper strip exits toward the foreground. A tiny orange adjustment pin and a restrained cyan edge on the guide suggest deliberate editing. Use one compact sculptural assembly with no extraneous props.
Style/medium: premium tactile editorial illustration, matte ceramic and folded paper, realistic soft studio shadows, crisp purposeful detail.
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; view from slightly above; entire assembly centered inside the inner 80% of the frame; all ribbons fully visible; generous calm margins; silhouette readable at 290-pixel card width.
Lighting/mood: calm, capable, precise, quietly technical, restrained cyan reflected light.
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027.
Constraints: every paper surface is blank; no text, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, symbols, labels, logos, trademarks, or watermarks; no paw imagery, paw logos, cats, or cat silhouettes; no product UI or Microsoft Fluent branding; no neon glow or decorative gradients.
Correction: Scale the entire sculptural assembly down substantially. Shorten all paper strips and keep every ribbon end and the guide completely inside the central 75% of the image, with at least 12% clear slate margin on every side. Preserve the same paper-and-ceramic style and the three-input-to-one-output metaphor.
